package rulefixtures

import (
	"strings"
)

// scenario for stable_value_normalization_in_inner_loop: Stable value normalization (ToLower, TrimSpace, etc.) repeated inside inner loops.
// fixture polarity: negative; family: hot_path; severity: info.
type Rule366NegativeTask struct {
	Owner string
	Tag   string
}

func scenario366Negative(tasks []Rule366NegativeTask) []string {
	var matched []string
	for _, task := range tasks {
		normalizedOwner := strings.ToLower(task.Owner)
		if normalizedOwner == "alice" {
			matched = append(matched, task.Tag)
		}
	}
	return matched
}
